To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the quality value loyalty model can be used to explain the relationship between customer loyalty and the quality value of products and services and that the pyramid model can be used as a framework to explain the relationship among technology, customer loyalty, and the quality value chain.

(1) the impact of technology on quality value loyalty is mediated by a set of factors that include customer perceptions of the quality value loyalty of the company, employee perceptions of the quality, value, and loyalty of the company and the employee-technology relationship, and the company-technology relationship; and (2) the impact of the company-employee-technology linkages on customer quality value loyalty is moderated by the company's quality value loyalty and customer perceptions of the company's technology-employee linkages
technology is a key driver of customer loyalty, and that the quality value loyalty model provides a useful framework for studying the impact of technology on customer loyalty.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of technology on customer loyalty and the role of technology in creating value for customers.
the impact of technology on quality, value, and loyalty, and the impact of these three constructs on the success of technology firms.
understanding and enhancing the quality value loyalty process in the context of technology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
technology has an important impact on the quality value chain.
technology has a significant effect on the customer loyalty chain.
technology can be a powerful driver of quality value and loyalty.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
technology is an important driver of quality and value, and both of those are critical drivers of customer loyalty.

the quality value loyalty (QVL) chain is an important conceptual model that has the potential for providing a useful basis for further research on technology customer linkages, technology employee linkages, and technology company links.
technology has an impact on each of the three links in the quality value loyalty (QVL) chain, but the nature and strength of the impact vary depending on the link.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the quality value loyalty framework is a useful lens through which to view the impact of technology on customer loyalty, and that there are many opportunities to further our understanding of this important phenomenon.

technology can have both positive and negative effects on the quality value chain and that the impact of technology on customer loyalty is contingent on the way technology is used by the customer and the company.
the quality value loyalty (QVL) chain is a useful conceptual tool for understanding and improving the customer experience.
